units.text: INT. PYGMALION - CONTINUOUS
Miss EYNSFORD HILL [going to him with confident familiarity] How do you do?
HIGGINS [staring at her] I’ve seen you before somewhere.
I haven’t the ghost of a notion where; but I’ve heard your voice. [Drearily] It doesn’t matter.
You’d better sit down.
I’m sorry to say that my celebrated son has no manners. You mustn’t mind him.
units.name: MRS. HIGGINS

units.text: MISS EYNSFORD HILL [gaily] I don’t. [She sits in the Elizabethan chair].
EYNSFORD HILL
units.name: MRS

units.text: a little bewildered.
Not at all.
units.name: MRS

units.text: She sits on the ottoman between her daughter and Mrs. Higgins, who has turned her chair away from the writing-table.
Oh, have I been rude? I didn’t mean to be.
units.name: HIGGINS

units.text: He goes to the central window, through which, with his back to the company, he contemplates the river and the flowers in Battersea Park on the opposite bank as if they were a frozen dessert.
The parlor-maid returns, ushering in Pickering.
Colonel Pickering
units.name: THE PARLOR-MAID

units.text: She withdraws.
How do you do, Mrs. Higgins?
units.name: PICKERING

units.text: So glad you’ve come. Do you know Mrs. Eynsford Hill—Miss Eynsford Hill?
units.name: MRS. HIGGINS

units.text: Exchange of bows.
The Colonel brings the Chippendale chair a little forward between Mrs. Hill and Mrs. Higgins, and sits down.
Has Henry told you what we’ve come for?
units.name: PICKERING

units.text: HIGGINS [over his shoulder] We were interrupted: damn it!
Oh Henry, Henry, really!
units.name: MRS. HIGGINS

units.text: EYNSFORD HILL
units.name: MRS

units.text: half rising.
Are we in the way?
units.name: MRS

units.text: HIGGINS
units.name: MRS

units.text: rising and making her sit down again.
No, no. You couldn’t have come more fortunately: we want you to meet a friend of ours.
units.name: MRS

units.text: HIGGINS [turning hopefully] Yes, by George!
We want two or three people.
You’ll do as well as anybody else.
The parlor-maid returns, ushering Freddy.
Mr. Eynsford Hill.
units.name: THE PARLOR-MAID

units.text: HIGGINS [almost audibly, past endurance] God of Heaven! another of them.
FREDDY [shaking hands with Mrs. Higgins] Ahdedo?
Very good of you to come.
units.name: MRS. HIGGINS

units.text: Introducing.
Colonel Pickering.
units.name: MRS. HIGGINS

units.text: FREDDY [bowing] Ahdedo?
I don’t think you know my son, Professor Higgins.
units.name: MRS. HIGGINS

units.text: FREDDY [going to Higgins] Ahdedo?
HIGGINS [looking at him much as if he were a pickpocket] I’ll take my oath I’ve met you before somewhere.
Where was it?
I don’t think so.
units.name: FREDDY

units.text: HIGGINS [resignedly] It don’t matter, anyhow.
Sit down.
He shakes Freddy’s hand, and almost slings him on the ottoman with his face to the windows; then comes round to the other side of it.
Well, here we are, anyhow!
units.name: HIGGINS

units.text: He sits down on the ottoman next Mrs. Eynsford Hill, on her left.
And now, what the devil are we going to talk about until Eliza comes?
units.name: HIGGINS

units.text: Henry: you are the life and soul of the Royal Society’s soirees; but really you’re rather trying on more commonplace occasions.
units.name: MRS. HIGGINS

units.text: Am I? Very sorry.
units.name: HIGGINS

units.text: Beaming suddenly.
